categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business segments include fiberglass (glass fiber) production and sales, fiberglass products manufacturing, and fiberglass reinforced composite materials. The company also operates through its subsidiary Tianma Group in resin production and chemical products. Main products include fiberglass yarn, chopped mat, wet-laid thin mat, fiberglass fabrics, composite separators, coated mat, mesh cloth, and thermoplastic fiberglass products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes pool kiln technology for fiberglass production, employing high-temperature melting, drawing, and post-processing techniques. Core manufacturing methods include wet-laid thin mat production, chopped mat manufacturing, and fiberglass composite material fabrication. The company has established intelligent manufacturing workshops and continuously improves production processes through technological innovation and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including construction and building materials, rail transit, petrochemicals, automotive manufacturing, electronics, and new energy sectors. Products are sold to customers across 30+ provinces in China and exported to 30+ countries and regions including North America, South America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Jiangsu Province, China, with headquarters in Changzhou. Domestic operations cover 30+ provinces across China. International presence includes significant export markets in North America, South America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa. Domestic revenue represents 75% of total revenue while international exports account for 25%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in fiberglass yarn production, midstream in fiberglass product manufacturing and processing, and downstream in fiberglass reinforced composite material production. The company possesses a complete integrated product chain from fiberglass production through product deep processing to composite material manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing green transformation and low-carbon production, developing high-performance fiberglass products, expanding into new energy and wind power applications, and enhancing product quality and production efficiency. R&D focuses on automotive lightweight materials, wind turbine blade applications, new energy vehicle battery separators, and high-performance composite materials. The company invested 131.89 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 5.06% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of fiberglass and composite materials. Domestic sales utilize direct sales and distribution models, while international sales employ an exclusive distributor model combined with industry trade shows. Revenue is recognized at the point when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic fiberglass manufacturer with the most complete integrated product chain in China. It is the largest non-woven fiberglass product manufacturer domestically and among the few capable of producing high-end fiberglass mat products. The company maintains strong competitive advantages in chopped mat and wet-laid thin mat segments, with market share exceeding 50% in domestic automotive roof mat applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 2.607 billion yuan, down 13.59% from 3.017 billion yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company was 296.08 million yuan, declining 63.77% year-over-year. Total assets reached 6.314 billion yuan, up 13.37% from 5.569 billion yuan at year-end 2022. The company is experiencing a contraction phase due to industry overcapacity and weak downstream demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product quality, complete integrated product chain, advanced manufacturing technology, and strong R&D capabilities. Key competitive advantages include market leadership in chopped mat and wet-laid thin mat segments, high-performance product development, cost efficiency through vertical integration, and established customer relationships across diverse industries. The company emphasizes quality assurance, technological innovation, and customized solutions for customer needs.
